original_hypothesis: Two hypotheses, run in order. (i) THE REFUTATION IS CHEATING. RV-377-075's row may be smuggling charged computation into its description through a 256-entry exponent table that is not a registered kind and whose reads are charged one SEL each; or treating its log constants differently from the way dk_precision treats its probability constants; or undercharging the max-subtraction renormalization; or not actually operating at 8 bits; or leaking the truth into the served answer. If any of these lands, RV-377-075 is reversed and RV-377-066 is restored. (ii) IF IT IS NOT CHEATING, THE RESIDUAL IS A COST STATEMENT. The 8-bit log row is admissible but costs 3 104 description bits and 208 charged activations per query against 596 and 12 for the wider-instrument rows, so it should be dominated COORDINATE-WISE - more expensive on desc AND on every per-use coefficient - by the wider rows, and therefore occupy no cell of any cross-instrument frontier at any reuse horizon. Precision would then buy DESCRIPTION and EXECUTION COST, not capability.

A1 - there is NO TABLE or MATERIALIZE kind in the registered universe and NONE of the five registered store kinds is native in B0, which realizes S_LOOKUP as a LINEAR SCAN with one EQ per entry; re-charged at that rate exec_q goes 208 -> 8 432 per query (x40.54), at the declared indexed amendment 560, and the table description goes 3 104 -> 3 618 bits under the store materialization basis; capability is BIT-IDENTICAL under all six regimes, so the attack does not land. A2 - 1 056 log constants and 256 table entries per (ecology, instrument) over 8 cells, recomputed by EXACT INTEGER COMPARISON with no floating point: 0 wrong; the treatment is exactly dk_precision's. A3 - 63 charged activations per event for the renormalization (31 GT, the minimum for a max over 32, plus 32 SUB) against a declared 63-64; undercharge of at most 1 activation per event, 24 of 1 512. A4 - 137 326 traced values at fx8 on E_ambig/A lie in exactly [-128, 127], 0 outside, 529 clamp events; recorded and not softened, the row's underflow guard compares against exp_lo = -255 which is not representable at fx8 and is INERT there because a clamped log-weight never falls below -128. A6 - A DEFECT FOUND IN THE REFUTING ROW: RV-377-075 charges its readout division only when the denominator is non-zero, so its charged op sequence is DATA-DEPENDENT (LOGBAYES8 3 290 043 at fx8/fx10/fx12 against 3 289 787 at fx16), which is exactly the control RV-377-066 enforced; repairing it restores identity; it moves no capability. A7 - A SECOND DEFECT: RV-377-075's own op counter never counts its table reads, understating charged_ops_total by 12 544 on the ambiguous ecology (392 queries x 32) and 25 088 on the noisy one, in 48 of 72 cells; the phase ledger R that the cost model reads is identical in all 72 cells, so no frontier moves. (2) FAILS. The frozen clause asserted domination on all five RAW coefficients. Under the reduced price and the flat basis the set of rows dominating LOGBAYES8@fx8 on the raw coefficients is EMPTY, because the log row is CHEAPER on upd_e: 95 against 356 for QCOUNT@fx10 and 1 971 for BAYESM@fx10. The clause was also wrong to name BAYESM@fx10, whose r-coefficient rho = 7 520.75 is 3.62x the log row's 2 075.75. The grid half holds: in all eight cross-instrument keys the H grid reaches 8 192 against a largest H-crossover of 75.0 and the r grid reaches 256 against a largest r-crossover of 23.25, past twice each PER AXIS, with both flags asserted in the receipt; and the exact asymptotic occupants as H -> infinity and as r -> infinity are QCOUNT (and BAYESM for H -> infinity), with LOGBAYES8@fx8 in NEITHER set. (5) HOLDS: the fx8 admissible set on E_ambig is exactly (LOGBAYES8), and it occupies 36 of 36 cells of the fx8 per-instrument frontier in all four keys - an empty field, not a victory. The capability axis is closed and the residual is a cost statement. (7) HOLDS: desc ratio 3 104/596 = 5.208054, exec_q ratio 208/12 = 17.333333 at RV-377-075's own table charge and 8 432/12 = 702.666667 at the registered B0 scan charge; native 96/4 = 24.0; rho 2 075.75/549 = 3.780965. (8) HOLDS: desc_scaled(LOGBAYES8@fx8) = 3 104 against desc_scaled(QCOUNT@fx10) = 668, ratio 4.646707, and the domination and the 0-cell occupancy are unchanged. (9) FAILS. Declared sequences D and E, never executed before this record, are BOTH ADMISSIBLE at fx8 on E_ambig - D at 0.910859 and E at 0.874273 - so neither disjunct of the frozen clause holds: the ambiguous split is 4-1, not 3-2 and not the preserved 2-1. The same numbers FALSIFY RV-377-075's OWN registered successor prediction that 'a fourth and fifth declared sequence will split roughly as A and C did against B'. Four concentration variables separate the four admissible ambiguous sequences from the one inadmissible one (maximum posterior weight, participation ratio, top-4 mass, var q*), and H1's flip-count-before-revocation does NOT (A 1, B 1, C 1, D 2, E 1). But B is the minimum on every separating variable by margins of 1e-4 to 1e-5 RELATIVE - max posterior weight 0.42912369 against 0.42914758 to 0.42916885; participation ratio 3.85406274 against 3.85325178 to 3.85363382 - against a capability gap of 0.473720. A 0.02 % difference in concentration cannot produce a 54 % difference in capability, so H3 separates in rank order and explains nothing. H2's first_flip_index also separates (B 9 against 0, 2, 5, 7) and names no mechanism either. (11) HOLDS: LOGBAYES8_NOMAXSUB is exactly 0/1 on all TEN declared sequence-cells, the two never-executed ones included. THE MECHANISM OF THE SEQUENCE-B FAILURE, FOUND AND PROVED BY A ONE-ENTRY INTERVENTION. The ecology is NOT what differs: the number of hypotheses whose exact posterior weight lies within a factor 2^k of the MAP weight is IDENTICAL on all five ambiguous sequences (5 within 2^3, 6 within 2^4, 8 within 2^5, 8 within 2^6, 8 within 2^7). At fx8 the exponent table has 256 entries A.const(2^(u/16)) for u in [-255, 0], and EXACTLY ONE of them is decided by a rounding TIE: at u = -80 the exact value 16*2^-5 = 0.5 is a half-integer, so A.const's half-UP rule sends it to raw 1 (= 1/16), DOUBLING a weight whose true value is 1/32, while half-DOWN sends it to 0. On sequence B three hypotheses of the declared class - indices 8, 12 and 28 - land with max-normalized log-weight EXACTLY -80 raw (log2 w = -5.000); on A, C, D and E none does. B therefore carries 9 non-zero readout weights against 6, the three extra carry 3/38 = 7.8947 % of the readout mass, and they are keyed on the COMPETING bit, so the served vector loses the symmetry the obligation has: B serves (0.625, 0.5, 0.6875, 0.5, 0.4375, 0.625, 0.5, 0.625) where A, C and E serve (0.625, 0.4375, 0.625, 0.4375, 0.4375, 0.625, 0.4375, 0.625) against a q* of (0.5891, 0.4109, 0.5891, 0.4109, 0.4109, 0.5891, 0.4109, 0.5891). Changing that SINGLE table entry from 1 to 0 - half-down tie-breaking, 1 of 256 entries, arithmetic, constants, events, scoring rule and theta untouched - moves B from 0.400545 to 0.874245 and ADMISSIBLE, leaves A (0.874265), C (0.874265), D (0.910859) and E (0.874273) bit-identical, leaves noisy B, C, D and E identical, IMPROVES noisy A from 0.979053 to 0.980446, and regresses NOTHING: one of ten sequence-cells flips and it is the only failing one.

strongest_parent_explanation: Log-domain updating buys DYNAMIC RANGE by spending DESCRIPTION: the exponent table and the log constants are the price of the representation, and every practical fixed-point Bayesian filter pays it. The classical statement is qualitative; the statement under test here is that, priced, the payment is large enough that the 8-bit log row never holds a frontier cell against a 10-bit linear row, so precision is a DESCRIPTION-COST parameter and not a capability parameter on this ecology.

mechanism_attribution: For the residual: DESCRIPTION and EXECUTION COST. The log representation buys dynamic range at 8 bits by paying for a 256-entry exponent table and 96 log constants, which is 3 104 description bits against 596, and by paying one table read per hypothesis per query, which is 208 charged activations per query against 12 (8 432 at the registered charge). For the sequence split: a SINGLE ROUNDING TIE-BREAK in a single exponent-table entry, not the event sequence, not the ecology and not the concentration of the posterior.
new_invariant_learned: At scope: (i) A GATE CLAIM AND A COST CLAIM FAIL DIFFERENTLY, and confusing them is how RV-377-066 died. Charging is not in the capability functional, so no charging finding - not a 256x undercharge, not two instrument defects - can reverse an admissibility verdict; and no capability finding settles occupancy. This record separates them explicitly and reports each attack against the thing it can actually move. (ii) DOMINATION MUST BE TESTED IN THE COORDINATES THE COST FUNCTION HAS, NOT THE COORDINATES THE RECEIPT PRINTS. The frozen cost is affine in (H, r) with three coefficients; testing five raw coefficients is sufficient but not necessary, and it made this record's own clause 2 fail while a true and stronger statement sat one line away. (iii) GAP DG-2 HAS TWO DISCHARGES AND A RECORD MUST SAY WHICH. Where a cost-coordinate dominator exists, 'no cell' is a theorem over the whole quadrant and no grid is needed; where it does not, the grid must pass twice the largest crossover PER AXIS. Reporting only the grid hides the fact that the theorem was available; reporting only the theorem hides the pairs it does not cover. (iv) A CAPABILITY THAT TURNS ON A ROUNDING TIE-BREAK IS AN INSTRUMENT ARTEFACT AND MUST BE PROVED AS ONE. The one sequence out of five on which the 8-bit log row fails is decided by one of 256 declared table entries - the unique one at a half-integer - and a one-entry intervention flips it while leaving the other nine sequence-cells bit-identical. Before attributing a per-sequence failure to the evidence, test whether a single rounding decision in a declared constant carries it. (v) OCCUPYING AN INSTRUMENT'S OWN FRONTIER MEANS NOTHING WHEN YOU ARE THE ONLY ADMISSIBLE ROW THERE. LOGBAYES8 holds 36 of 36 fx8 cells and 0 of 42, 49, 294 and 899 joint cells; protocol rule 17 applied per instrument reports an empty field as a victory, and a kingdom question must therefore be asked on the CROSS-INSTRUMENT frontier, which is the frontier RV-377-066 never computed.
new_theory_constraint: Protocol rule 25: a row that reads a DECLARED CONSTANT TABLE must charge every read at the registered emulation cost of the basis it runs on; a table is not a free indirection, and in B0 - where no store kind is native - a table read is a linear scan, one EQ per entry. Protocol rule 26: when one declared cell or sequence fails while its siblings pass, the record must test whether a single rounding decision in a declared constant carries the difference, by a one-entry intervention with all else held fixed, before attributing the failure to the ecology or the evidence. Protocol rule 27: a 'no cell exists' clause must state which of the two DG-2 discharges it uses - a cost-coordinate domination, which is a theorem over the whole non-negative quadrant, or a grid extended past twice the largest crossover PER AXIS - and must report the pairs that only the second covers. GMI-DA5 is further scoped: the arithmetic instrument is neither a kingdom parameter (RV-377-075) nor merely a substrate parameter - on this ecology it is a DESCRIPTION-COST parameter, and whether it is even that is a property of the ecology, since on E_noisy an 8-bit row holds the joint frontier everywhere. Gap DG-6's closure experiment is unchanged but its premise is corrected: the eleven reduction verdicts inherit an instrument qualifier AND a state-encoding qualifier (rule 24), and re-adjudicating them wide is now a COST question, not a capability one.
